title: Answer
description:
A new covenant was promised to this people: God’s laws written inside them, a knowing of God that does not depend on one neighbor teaching another, and sins remembered no more.

The first covenant is the one He made when He led them out. Its failure is located in the people, not in the terms having been false.

Words kept on the doorposts are not the same as law God Himself writes on the heart.

Remember no more is spoken by the God who saw the bondage and the wilderness. It is His own ending of the remembrance of sins.

The first is obsolete because what was promised has displaced it. It is not obsolete as though it had never been from God.
